Messages.Body:
1> When I play Obediance after a Wake With The Evening Freshness, do I untap the reacting vampire ?(on Obediance, it's written : "leave this vampire untap" not "untap this vampire"...)

2> Can I play a major Boon on my predator ? ( Very efficient against Dominate-Obfuscate Bleeds )

3> And on my prey? ("I protect you against me...")

4> Is malkavian deck the best? (+6 Bleed, +6 Stealth...)

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
eca...@irisa.fr (Erwan Cario) writes:
>
>1> When I play Obediance after a Wake With The Evening Freshness, do I untap the reacting vampire ?(on Obediance, it's written : "leave this vampire untap" not "untap this vampire"...)

No, since it doesn't say untap this Vampire.
Answer from the Design Team : (11/9/94):
>Obedience:
> Can be used if blocking vampire is tapped, but this will not untap the
> blocking vampire.

>2> Can I play a major Boon on my predator ? ( Very efficient against Dominate-Obfuscate Bleeds )

Sure.

>3> And on my prey? ("I protect you against me...")

Sure.

>4> Is malkavian deck the best? (+6 Bleed, +6 Stealth...)

I don't do religion questions. (IBM vs. Mac, SNES vs. Sega, etc.;-)
